metadata.question: Was there an active fire present near Paradise, California between November 7, 2018 to November 10, 2018?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Collection: MODIS/061/MOD14A1 (Thermal Anomalies & Fire Daily, 1km).
- Date: 2018-11-07 to 2018-11-10 (inclusive).
- Location: Paradise, California (Point at [-121.6219, 39.7596]) buffered to 15 km to capture nearby fire pixels.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- No cloud masking needed; fire product already encodes detections. Use FireMask >= 4 (low/nominal/high confidence) and MaxFRP > 0 as evidence.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collection size == 0 => C1.
- If valid pixel count == 0 after masking => C2.
- If any computed value is null/NaN or invalid => C3.
- If fire pixel count > 0 => A (Yes), else B (No).
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const geom = ee.Geometry.Point([-121.6219, 39.7596]).buffer(15000);
    const start = '2018-11-07';
    const end = '2018-11-11'; // end is exclusive in filterDate

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    const col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD14A1')
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filterBounds(geom);

    const n = await col.size().getInfo();
    console.log(`Collection: MODIS/061/MOD14A1`);
    console.log(`Date: 2018-11-07 to 2018-11-10, Images: ${n}`);
    if (!n || n === 0) {
      console.log(`No images in date/location window.`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing
    // Combine days by max to capture any detection within the period.
    const fmMax = col.select('FireMask').max();
    const frpMax = col.select('MaxFRP').max();

    // Valid pixel counts (where FireMask is defined)
    const validCount = await fmMax.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('FireMask').getInfo();

    if (validCount === null || validCount === undefined) {
      console.log(`Valid pixel count is null.`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if (validCount === 0) {
      console.log(`No valid pixels after processing.`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation
    // Fire pixels: FireMask >= 4 (low/nominal/high confidence)
    const fireMask = fmMax.gte(4);
    const fireCount = await fireMask.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('FireMask').getInfo();

    // Max FRP as additional evidence
    const maxFrpVal = await frpMax.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.max(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('MaxFRP').getInfo();

    if ([fireCount, maxFrpVal].some(v => v === null || Number.isNaN(v))) {
      console.log(`Computation returned null/NaN.`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    const pct = (fireCount > 0 && validCount > 0) ? (100.0 * fireCount / validCount) : 0;
    console.log(`Valid pixels: ${validCount}`);
    console.log(`Fire pixels (FireMask>=4): ${fireCount} (${pct.toFixed(2)}%)`);
    console.log(`Max FRP (MW): ${maxFrpVal}`);

    if (fireCount > 0 || (maxFrpVal !== null && maxFrpVal > 0)) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
